rows.medi_said: How do you say languages in it? Loka, lokat?
rows.why: He asked for the word for language(s); she supplied لغة (not on her sheet); his loka/luka is an S4 ق/غ slip.

rows.medi_said: يعني ،شو يعني شو لا-- what... What language?
rows.amal_said: No بلاقي، إنتا بتلاقي، شو لقيت؟
rows.why: He did not understand her لقيت and answered 'what language?'; she explained the verb (sheet: i find | Ana balaaqi | أنا بلاقي).

rows.medi_said: أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير
rows.why: He meant a method, not a road; sheet 'way / method | Tariqa | طريقة'; she asked which and he fixed to طريقة.
rows.english: I found a very good method

rows.medi_said: أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير
rows.why: طريقة is feminine so the adjective should be منيحة; she only fixed the noun.

rows.medi_said: الأحسن طريقة
rows.why: A comparative never takes el-; she recast شو أحسن طريقة.

rows.medi_said: To learn would be أتأل--
rows.why: He stalled on the verb and asked whether it is for 'me' or just 'to learn'; she supplied أتعلم (sheet: learn | et3allam | تعلّم).

rows.medi_said: Okay. أتعلم لغة جديد
rows.why: لغة is feminine so it needs جديدة; Amal moved on with بس.

rows.medi_said: بقدر آم أصلح، أصلحه آم…
rows.amal_said: أصلّحها بي لأنه مشكلة is a feminine
rows.why: The object pronoun on the verb must be feminine -ha for مشكلة; she named the rule and he repeated أصلّحها.
rows.english: if I can fix it (the problem)

rows.medi_said: I excited؟ أنا بهمس.
rows.why: He wanted 'I get excited' and produced the make-X shape without the reflexive ت; she gave بتحمس (sheet: i get excited | Ana bat7ammas | أنا بتحمس).

rows.medi_said: shit! أنا بتحمس. amm أنا بتحمس شو بنقدر
rows.amal_said: So neither not تحمس not بهمِس. What is it?
rows.why: He meant the state 'I am excited', which is the participle; she asked 'you are excited or you get excited?' and prompted until he said أنا متحمس, ✓ صح at 04:26.

rows.medi_said: متحمس من possibility.
rows.why: Sheet row 'excited | mit7ammes | متحمس لَ' fixes the preposition as لـ, not من; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: أي كلمات، مشكلة، مشكل-- yeah. عندي
rows.why: After the question word أي the noun stays singular (same logic as kam + singular); she recast كلمات as كلمة and he repeated it.
rows.english: which words I have a problem with

rows.medi_said: أي كلمة مشكلة اللي-
rows.why: With the object fronted the preposition needs the pointer ending فيها; he tried اللي, she finished the sentence and he repeated it at 07:18.
rows.english: which word I have a problem with

rows.medi_said: il grammar. Do I know grammar?
rows.why: He asked for the word; she supplied قواعد (not on her sheet).

rows.medi_said: What is, what is to repeat?
rows.amal_said: Repeat يعني أنا بعيد is I repeat.
rows.why: He asked for the verb; she supplied بعيد (sheet only has far | Ba3eed | بعيد, not this verb).

rows.medi_said: ana بعيد الـ، الـ نفس مش الـ-
rows.why: In نفس + noun only the second word takes el- (sheet: same | Nafs); he still said الـ نفس مشكلة again at 08:44 after her fix.

rows.medi_said: مش ذكي. ل-لما الـ سؤال ما عند-- ما عنده، جواب
rows.amal_said: صحيح. لما ما يكون عنده جواب للـ السؤال
rows.wrong: لما الـ سؤال ما عنده جواب
rows.right: لما ما يكون عنده جواب للسؤال
rows.why: After لما the 'has' clause needs يكون; she recast with ما يكون عنده and moved السؤال to the end.
rows.english: when it doesn't have an answer to the question

rows.medi_said: an easy answer, I should say.
rows.why: He said 'easy' in English where the sheet has 'easy | Sahel | سهل' and she translated جواب سهل; low because the clause was an English aside, then he repeated جواب سهل.

rows.medi_said: ... ووا ال أول مشكلة.
rows.why: أول + noun works like idafa (sheet: Awal el-yoam), the first word takes no el-; she moved to English.

rows.medi_said: al-, el ghayr tariqa-
rows.why: غير + noun takes no el- (sheet: other/different | 8air | غير); he repeated ghayr tariqa.

rows.medi_said: Muhadatha? ... Shuyani. Muhadath-... I don't remember.
rows.why: She asked him what محادثة means and he did not know; she gave 'conversation' (sheet: conversation practice | Mu7aadase | محادثة).

rows.medi_said: Okay. Yeah. I, and, muhadatha ma qalil kalima.
rows.why: The adjective goes after the noun and the noun should be plural (sheet: word – words | Kelme | كلمة); she did not react.

rows.medi_said: that was zaj. What shuu, shu yanni banzaj?
rows.why: He asked the meaning of her verb (sheet: i get annoyed | Ana banze3ej | أنا بنزعج).

rows.medi_said: Bahrej. Bahrej. Shu yanni?
rows.why: He asked the meaning (sheet: i embarrass | Ana ba7rej | أنا بحرج; i get embarrassed | Ana ban7erej | أنا بنحرج).

rows.medi_said: maruj baru... Is it m-maruj? M-mitruj?
rows.why: He tried to build the participle 'embarrassed' with a mit- pattern; she gave the ma-CCuuC shape محروج (his maruj is the same word with ح dropped, S4).

rows.medi_said: Oh my God, bees. What was bees? Bee.
rows.why: He asked for the word (sheet: bees (general) | Na7el | نحل).

rows.medi_said: Ana hakeet ma khatibti ashan Arabiyi. Arabiyi, aswad or-
rows.why: Reaching for 'bad' he used aswad, which is black on her sheet (black (m/f) | Aswad | أسود); she supplied سيء (bad | Sayyi2 | سيء).
rows.english: my Arabic is bad / getting worse

rows.medi_said: getting worse so she would it be akun, akunsayye'?
rows.why: 'Is getting worse' is a change happening now: 3am + بصير, not أكون; he repeated baseer sayyee'.

rows.medi_said: Bansabit? But-
rows.amal_said: No, forget everything. Bas ihkili shi ya'ani happy as a siffa.
rows.why: Asked for 'happy' as an adjective he gave the verb بنبسط; she prompted for the صفة and he reached مبسوط at 27:54, confirmed 28:11 (sheet: happy | Mabsoo6 | مبسوط).

rows.medi_said: so بيسبوت بيسبيت sorry بيسبت.
rows.amal_said: هلأ ليش هلأ الباء أول واحدة ... the present بس بضل be here and verb is BC6 or T. So bib set two Bs
rows.why: He kept the present b- but lost the root's ب; she spelled out prefix b- plus root b-s-6 and he got بييبستني at 33:04 (could equally be an S4 letter slip).

rows.medi_said: sorry هية بتيبست- يبستوا and احنا بين- بينبست.
rows.why: For احنا the present prefix is بن-, he used the بي- of هو; her one-word prompt احنا made him redo it (his بنسبت at 34:21 is an S4 letter slip she fixed to بنبسط).

rows.medi_said: I made him basato.
rows.why: At 36:37 she set basato = he made him vs basatto = I made him; he used the he-form for 'I made him' and her echo does not show a fix.

rows.medi_said: basati is she, she makes happy right?
rows.amal_said: No,- Or you make happy female ...that's you. You make happy.
rows.why: He read the -ti past ending as 'she'; she said no, it is you-feminine.

rows.medi_said: Lama hake- when you talk about finding work. ... when I tell you about what I found.
rows.why: He heard her past you-f حكيتيلي as present or as I-tell-you; she repeated it until he got 'when you told me' at 42:15.

rows.medi_said: And about you.
rows.why: He read إنك as 'about you'; she gave 'that you'.

rows.medi_said: when I tell you about what I found.
rows.why: He took her لقيتي (sheet: you (f) found | inti la2aiti) as 'what I found'; he got 'you found' at 42:31.

rows.medi_said: بستي، بستو.
rows.amal_said: No. ليش ما منحط إي بدنا إي ... بست. إبست We do need an E.
rows.why: The command of a three-consonant verb takes the helping إ; he then produced ابست، ابستي، ابسطو at 44:25, ✓.

rows.medi_said: is it nabasit or is it, nabasat? Or nabast?
rows.amal_said: So if you add E it's gonna be easier to say. So inbasat.
rows.why: The past of the n-verb needs the helping i-: انبسط; he was guessing and she supplied it, he repeated Inbasat.

rows.medi_said: this would be embasattet, right? Embassatet il hafla.
rows.amal_said: EMBASATI. I need a preposition. What was it? Do you remember? ... Bi or fi.
rows.why: انبسط takes بـ or في before its object; he forgot, she prompted and supplied bi/fi, and at 54:50 accepted both.

rows.medi_said: this would be embasattet, right? Embassatet il hafla.
rows.why: Addressing Amal (feminine) the past ending is -ti; he used the masculine -et and she said EMBASATI.

rows.medi_said: in, in basatu. ... In basatu Their trip. Safarhom.
rows.why: Same verb, same fixed preposition بـ before the object; he dropped it again and she prompted 'fee preposition shoo', he said Bi safar hom.

rows.medi_said: In basatu Their trip. Safarhom. Safarhom.
rows.why: سفرة (sheet: (travel) trip | Safra | سفرة) is feminine so it grows -t before the owner ending -hom; he repeated Safarthom.

rows.medi_said: Inti beten bestiti
rows.why: The you-f present ending is a single -i; he doubled it and she recast, he repeated Betenbisti.

rows.medi_said: Ana, ana ban biscuit. ashann ihna aa taalam natal ana naataallam
rows.why: 3ashaan meaning 'because' keeps the present b-; he gave bare نتعلم and wavered between ana and ihna, she recast احنا بنتعلم.

rows.medi_said: ihna bantalaam bass Hadi al filll
rows.why: فعل is masculine so the demonstrative is hada, not hadi; he repeated Hada al fill and she confirmed at 59:10.

rows.medi_said: Enjoy your day So command tensing Investii yomek
rows.why: انبسط needs بـ before its object (sheet: Enbes6u bi-re7letkom); she inserted bi and he then asked to put the preposition in the homework.

rows.medi_said: Did you say أحسن or أكثر؟ أحسن right?
rows.why: He misheard her أكتر (the most) as أحسن (the best); she corrected and at 1:01:15 separated أحسن إشي = the best thing.

rows.medi_said: So الأكتر إشي-
rows.why: A comparative never takes el-; she said no أل.

rows.why: He wanted to insert illi before the verb; she said there is no illi here, and he built أكتر إشي بيبسطني.

rows.why: Asked for the make-happy verb he gave a he-form with swapped letters; she drilled ببسط five times (sheet: i cause happiness | Ana babse6 | أنا ببسط); part of this is an S4 letter slip.

rows.medi_said: عافيا فيكي. شكرًا.
